grammar.purpose: Report experience without claiming a current event
grammar.explanation: 去过 means having had the experience. 没去过 denies experience; 不去 is refusal or a plan not to go. 去过 does not specify when, so add 前年 when relevant. 不要 infer that a museum is open now from having visited it before. The particle is neutral guo, unlike full-tone guò in passing by.

examples.py: wǒ qù guo , dàn bù shì jīn nián .
examples.en: I have been, but not this year.

examples.py: wǒ méi qù guo nà gè dì fāng .
examples.en: I have never been to that place.

examples.py: qián nián wǒ cān guān guo nà lǐ .
examples.en: I visited it the year before last.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不去过。意思是没有这个经历。

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 过：曾经发生的经历
grammar.purpose: Separate experience, plans and current confirmation
grammar.explanation: 我坐过船 but 今天船还没开 separates a past experience from today’s departure. 我想参观 is a desire, not a completed visit. 我去年去的 answers the time of an established event; 我去过 answers whether the experience exists. A trip can have occurred without establishing present conditions or expertise.

examples.zh: 我坐过船，今天还要看发船时间。
examples.py: wǒ zuò guo chuán , jīn tiān hái yào kàn fā chuán shí jiān .
examples.en: I have taken a boat before; today I still need to check its departure time.

examples.zh: 她想参观，还没有参观过。
examples.py: tā xiǎng cān guān , hái méi yǒu cān guān guo .
examples.en: She wants to visit and has not visited before.

examples.zh: 这辆车我没骑过，先问怎么骑。
examples.py: zhè liàng chē wǒ méi qí guo , xiān wèn zěn me qí .
examples.en: I have never ridden this bicycle; first ask how to ride it.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我去过，所以今天一定开门。
commonMistakes.right: 我去过，但今天开不开要确认。
commonMistakes.why: A past visit cannot confirm today’s opening.
